scope: Make authenticated PRE-CU combat select its Core3 hit/secondary-defense route before inherited NGE result tables, calculate primary and secondary defense only from Publish-era skill modifiers rather than NGE combat level, preserve authored three-pool HAM costs, and prevent retained NGE modifier, immediate action-drain, action-burn, delayed action-regeneration, direct damage-dealt multiplier, direct weapon-speed override, critical-override, Luck-derived hit-table, Forsake Fear channel-heal, radar-invisibility, global command-cooldown-execution, Force Sensitive saber-intercept, Smuggler pistol-whip control, Smuggler trick-derived modifier buffs, Officer Aggro Channel hate transfer, or Commando kill-meter/snare-armor expertise from becoming player combat authority through admission, refresh, persistence, effect handlers, delayed callbacks, stale script variables or modifiers, extra Action or Health drains or heals, mutated player scale or weapon state, hidden map/radar state, global command lockout, damage redirection, movement control, hate reassignment, armor mutation, or unconditional damage consumers while retaining expansion data and non-player compatibility.

findings: Publish 14.1 attack admission, primary accuracy, secondary defense, and HAM costs are skill-, weapon-, posture-, and command-authored rather than expertise-driven.
All retained profession and NPC combat actions are already authenticated by precu_combat_overrides.tab, and every row supplies an explicit target pool and PRE-CU HAM-cost model.

The previous dispatcher could select the inherited NGE hit tables through a fallback sentinel even after entering PRE-CU resolution; current complete family profiles made that unlikely, but the control-flow boundary was not fail-closed.

Pinned Core3 builds primary defense and weapon-matched secondary defense exclusively from named skill modifiers, private modifiers, posture, and Center of Being; it does not seed either calculation from combat level.

The inherited Java hit engine performed two unused combat-level reads on every damaging attack and seeded both authenticated PRE-CU defense calculations with defender combat level, giving an NGE statistic direct authority over hit and secondary-defense outcomes.

Single-target PRE-CU actions reached the inherited success-based free-shot helper after their authored HAM cost was calculated, allowing five NGE freeshot skill modifiers to replace the cost with zero.
Area costs remain drained once before the hit engine; their per-defender success-cost result must remain zero to prevent duplicate drains.
The authenticated Publish-era stripped-skillmod corpus has SHA-256 b2520748b03006faef7357372ea1e7eb7adbe5e52a8abd34db604b48a3e513a3 and contains zero display_only_* combat-stat keys.

The inherited NGE expertise listing retains thirteen display_only_* rows, while base_player previously recalculated and rewrote thirteen NGE combat statistics after login, equipment, armor, buff, and skill-mod events.

Twenty-two production callbacks remain attached to the cleanup handler, which removes fourteen known legacy keys—including one cleanup-only historical key—without reading combat statistics or writing skill modifiers.

The retained Teras Kasi meditate lifecycle already follows pinned Publish 14.1 DOT and wound-healing semantics, but inherited runtime also selected one of three persistent fs_meditate_* buffs every third Force Sensitive meditation tick; their effects are NGE expertise, resource-quality, and modified-primary-stat bonuses.
Those three compatibility rows remain loadable, while login cleanup and meditate admission remove persisted state and the meditation tick now runs only the authenticated PRE-CU trance lifecycle.

The NGE bh_shields action is centrally denied, but a persisted player.skill.bh_shields attachment and its buff handler could still react to damage, reattach the script, and seed shield, block, or charged buffs outside command admission.

The exact four Bounty Hunter shield compatibility rows remain available to retained later-content NPCs, while player login, generic buff admission, handler attachment, script attachment/initialization, and damage callbacks now all fail closed and remove persisted state.
The retained NGE Force Sensitive phase tree can persist fs_buff_def_1_1/fs_buff_ca_1 and their expertise-derived child effects independently of the centrally denied fs_* action handlers.

The shared legacy glancing-result block also probed expertise_fs_general_alacrity_1 without using its return value and then played the Jedi alacrity particle for every glancing result; the classic damage reduction and glancing message remain, while that unconditional NGE skill/effect side path is retired.

The inherited Commando default-heavy-attack free-cost, expertise devastation, and automatic level-tiered passive DOT path is also absent; authenticated PRE-CU command damage and hate routing remain authoritative.

Player lifecycle cleanup, generic buff admission, the stance add handler, and stance/focus query helpers now fail closed over all 34 known state names; 33 compatibility rows and one historical cleanup-only name remain retained, while the distinct PRE-CU brawler centerOfBeing/centerofbeing path is untouched.

The retained 1,993-row buff catalog contains 966 compatibility rows with 187 distinct NGE expertise, modified-primary-stat, Beast Master, fast-attack, DOT-immunity, item-writer, or later combat-modifier effect parameters; 166 rows mix one of those parameters with another content effect, so effect-writer guards alone could still leave misleading persisted player state.

All 187 later-era effect parameters remain mapped by 195 retained effect-mapping rows. A shared five-slot predicate now denies or removes the entire data-driven buff only for player targets, before an existing buff can be refreshed, while retained rows and non-player expansion encounter behavior remain available.

Eight retained commandGrant mappings are referenced by ten buff rows, including two rows that contain no retired NGE modifier. Shared player-only admission, lifecycle cleanup, and add/remove handler guards now deny or revoke all eight commands while retaining the rows and non-player content path.

The only actionDrain mapping is immediate_action_drain, owned by the persistent NGE Bounty Hunter bh_intimidate buff and the mixed-effect Medic me_traumatize_1 buff. Its add handler immediately capped and drained the target's Action, then applied the retained action_drain_immunity control buff.

Pinned Core3 has no immediate_action_drain mapping or actionDrain handler. Exact player-only admission, lifecycle removal, and an add-handler guard now retire that immediate player drain while preserving ordinary PRE-CU HAM costs and combat Action damage plus both retained rows and the non-player expansion path.

The only actionBurn mapping is action_burn, owned by five persistent later-era content rows. Both inherited action-cost overloads read its cached value, timestamped the state, charged an additional proportional Health cost, and emitted NGE crippling-pain combat spam after calculating the authored Action cost.

Pinned Core3 has no action_burn mapping, actionBurn handler, or secondary Health drain tied to Action costs. Exact player-only admission, lifecycle removal, script-variable-tree cleanup, add/remove handler guards, and cleanup before both inherited consumers now retire that player authority while retaining all five rows and the non-player expansion encounter path.

The only actionRegen mapping is action_regen, owned only by the persistent NGE Spy sp_action_regen buff. Its add handler cached maximum Action and scheduled a once-per-second callback that healed the full cached pool over fifteen ticks, while generic buff admission did not classify the row.

Pinned Core3 has no sp_action_regen, action_regen mapping, or actionRegenBuff callback. Exact player-only admission, lifecycle removal, add-handler guard, and delayed-callback guard now retire that inherited player authority while retaining the row and non-player compatibility path.

The only damageDealtMod mapping is damage_dealt_mod, referenced by eleven persistent rows: the NGE Beast Master bm_enrage player buff, eight Exar Kun sacrifice stages, and two heroic add mechanics. Its handler writes an unconditional raw-damage multiplier and enlarges the target by 30 percent, while the raw-damage consumer previously read that state for players and NPCs alike.

Pinned Core3 has no damage_dealt_mod, damageDealtMod, or bm_enrage override. Player-only generic admission, lifecycle cleanup, both handler guards, recorded-scale repair, and cleanup immediately before the raw-damage read now retire that inherited player authority while retaining every row and the non-player expansion encounter path.

The only weaponSpeedMod mapping is weapon_speed_mod, owned only by the persistent NGE Beast Master bm_frenzy buff. Its handler directly mutates the equipped weapon attack speed and marks that weapon as a creature weapon, so stale player state could bypass authenticated Publish-era cadence even after Beast Master skill admission was retired.

Pinned Core3 has ordinary skill-mod-driven weapon-speed calculations but no bm_frenzy, weapon_speed_mod, weaponSpeedMod, or recordedAttackSpeed compatibility state. Player-only admission and handler guards now fail closed, lifecycle cleanup removes persisted state, and an ownership-bounded repair restores the recorded positive speed before clearing stale markers.

Four retained critical-override effect mappings are used only by three NGE Smuggler expertise buffs. They bypassed both modifier and proc classification, and their critDoubleDamage and critRoot script variables were consumed unconditionally by the inherited damage wrapper even for authenticated PRE-CU attacks.

Exact player-only data admission, persisted-buff cleanup, eight effect-handler guards, four stale script-variable removals, and cleanup-before-read combat guards now retire that NGE expertise path while preserving the retained rows and non-player expansion compatibility.

The retained NGE Smuggler Skullduggery and Impossible Odds effects are exactly two persistent four-second buffs mapped through missByLuck and hitByLuck. Their handlers derive values from the NGE Luck primary statistic and expertise modifiers, then write missByLuck, hitByLuck, and increaseHitByLuck modifiers into inherited miss and defender-hit tables.

Pinned Core3 contains none of those two effects, handlers, commands, or three transient modifier names. Exact player-only admission, lifecycle removal, stale-modifier cleanup, and all four add/remove handler guards now retire that player authority while preserving both rows, both mappings, and non-player expansion compatibility.

The retained NGE Force Sensitive Forsake Fear expertise grants fs_forsake_fear and owns exactly one persistent ten-second buff mapped through expertiseChannelActionHeal. Its add/remove handlers and two delayed callbacks maintain five channel-state keys, a shared countdown SUI, and up to ten one-second pulses that heal Action by six percent per pulse for the player and eligible group members.

Pinned Core3 has no fs_forsake_fear, expertise_channel_action_heal, channelForsakeFear, or Forsake Fear channel-state path. The shared fs_* command gate and modifier-buff admission already reject fresh player use; exact player-only lifecycle cleanup, countdown-PID ownership validation, and five handler/callback guards now also retire persisted removal heals, delayed pulses, and stale state while preserving the retained row, mapping, skill, and non-player expansion compatibility.

The only radarInvis effect mapping is radar_invis, referenced by exactly three retained later-era buffs: Commando Mirror Armor, Bounty Hunter Take Cover, and queued-battlefield radar invisibility. Its generic add handler directly hid an actor from map and radar without a PRE-CU player-era boundary.

Pinned Core3 has no radar_invis, radarInvis, or co_mirror_armor player mechanic. Exact player-only admission, persisted-buff cleanup, ownership-bounded visibility repair, and both add/remove handler guards now retire that player authority while preserving all three rows and non-player expansion compatibility.

The only cooldownModify effect mapping is cooldown_execute_all, referenced by exactly three retained rows: the retired NGE Spy stifle, heroic Axkva Lelli mine stun, and Jedi statue dark-side debuff. Its add handler enumerated every player command and forced every command cooldown group to at least the data-authored duration.

Pinned Core3 preserves individual command timers but has no cooldown_execute_all, cooldownModify, or global learned-command lockout mechanic. Exact player-only admission, persisted-buff cleanup, and the add-handler guard now retire that NGE player authority while preserving all three data rows and non-player expansion content compatibility.

The only saberIntercept mapping is saber_intercept, owned by the persistent fs_saber_intercept buff granted from the retained NGE class_forcesensitive_phase3_novice row. Its add handler writes the caster into the shared damage_redirect state, causing incoming attacks against the recipient to be redirected to another actor.

Pinned Core3 contains no saber_intercept, saberIntercept, fs_saber_intercept, or player damage_redirect mechanic. The existing fs_* command and class_* progression gates already deny ordinary player acquisition and execution; exact player-only buff admission, persisted cleanup, and add-handler denial now close direct injection or restoration while retaining the mapping, buff, skill row, remove cleanup, and non-player expansion compatibility.

The retained NGE Smuggler pistol-whip rider has exactly one sm_pistol_whip mapping and one persistent two-second debuff row. Its custom add handler reads expertise_stun_line_sm_pistol_whip from the caster and can invoke the generic movement handler's stun path outside the centrally denied sm_* command execution boundary.

Pinned Core3 has no sm_pistol_whip or its expertise statistic, while it explicitly retains the distinct Publish 14.1 pistolMeleeDefense1 and pistolMeleeDefense2 commands. Exact player-only admission, persisted cleanup, and add-handler denial now retire only the NGE control rider while preserving both PRE-CU Pistoleer commands, the retained data row, remove cleanup, and non-player expansion compatibility.

The retained NGE Smuggler Sly Lie and Fast Talk tricks have exactly two effect mappings, two persistent buff rows, and two command rows owned by the later class_smuggler_phase1 tree. Their custom handlers read expertise_half_truth, expertise_innocent_cargo, and expertise_fake_id before attempting to write dodge, strikethrough, and modified-Agility state outside the centrally denied sm_* command boundary.

Pinned Core3 contains none of the two trick effects, three expertise statistics, or three transient modifier labels, while it retains the distinct Publish 14.1 combat_smuggler tree and its feignDeath, panicShot, lowBlow, lastDitch, and five slicing grants. Exact player-only admission, persisted and orphan-modifier cleanup, and both pre-expertise handler guards now retire only the two NGE trick buffs while preserving the retained data, remove cleanup, non-player behavior, and all classic Smuggler commands.

The retained NGE Officer Aggro Channel path has exactly two infinite-duration persistent effect rows and three expertise ranks; its target handler creates a paired self buff, the self handler caches aggroBuffTransfer, and the inherited damage path subtracts an expertise percentage of player hate and assigns it to the cached actor.

Pinned Core3 contains no of_aggro_channel command, aggro channel buff pair, expertise_aggro_channel statistic, or player hate-transfer mechanic. The existing of_* player command gate remains authoritative; exact player-only five-slot admission, lifecycle and orphan-script-variable cleanup, a pre-write add-handler guard, and cleanup before the hate consumer now close direct injection and persistence while retaining every data row, paired remove behavior, and non-player expansion compatibility.

The retained NGE Commando reaction surface has exactly three kill_meter_co_* combat actions and one expertise_co_* proc. You'll Regret That is the only commandoSnareBonus mapping and owns one persistent thirty-second co_youll_regret_that buff plus four expertise ranks; its add handler checks snare state, reads expertise_youll_regret_that, and attempts to write an expertise_innate_protection_all modifier under the transient commandoInnateArmorBonus label.

Pinned Core3 contains none of the four deferred Commando actions, commando_snare_bonus effect, co_youll_regret_that buff, expertise_youll_regret_that statistic, or transient armor modifier. The player-only Commando action gate now covers co_*, kill_meter_co_*, and expertise_co_* while exact five-slot buff admission, lifecycle and orphan-modifier cleanup, and a pre-snare/pre-expertise add-handler guard close direct injection and persistence; all retained rows and non-player expansion compatibility remain available.
